allow_instructions: Allow routine local development: reading/searching the workspace, running tests, formatters, linters, builds, and non-destructive git status/diff/log/add/commit on personal or ticket branches.
Allow installing packages into the current project or the user's venv when that is clearly part of the user's request.
Prefer allowing shell and MCP calls that stay inside the current workspace and do not touch secrets, production, or shared trunk branches.
block_instructions: Any force-push, rewrite of shared history, or push directly to main/master/trunk should ask for approval.
Destructive recursive deletes (rm -rf) outside the current workspace or of .git, home config, or credential directories should ask for approval.
Commands that read or exfiltrate secrets (.env, credentials, tokens, private keys, cloud auth) or change production systems should ask for approval.
sudo, privilege escalation, disk formatting, and machine power/user management should ask for approval or be blocked.
